title: TypeNote — Turn Your Mac Keyboard Into an Instrument

meta.name: description
meta.content: TypeNote is a free macOS menu bar app that turns your keyboard into a musical instrument. Every keystroke plays a note — 128 sounds, your own melodies, under 8ms latency.
